patch.value: Backfill legacy closure metadata and assign ownership for the LICENSE artifact

pm validate is structurally healthy with no drift or dangling references, but reports one legacy closed task without close_reason, 21 closed items missing issue-resolution fields, and LICENSE as an unowned tracked artifact. Backfill only evidence-supported metadata without rewriting history manually or inventing facts.

LICENSE is linked to the item that owns release and licensing policy; every closed item satisfies its type-specific close and resolution metadata using evidence from its immutable history commits and PRs; pm validate reports no metadata resolution or file-ownership warnings; history drift remains zero and no duplicate item is created

value.note: unowned release artifact requiring durable PM ownership
